note: Authored and fallback lines by intent and style key. Each line is one sentence of at most 12 words (fallback: 20). A pool may hold a single line.

default: Keep back; I won't tolerate threats.
Threaten me again and you'll regret it.
Lower your tone; I won't be threatened.
Watch how you speak to me.
swear: Say that again and see what happens.
patient: You can be upset without taking it out on me.
I understand you're angry, but speak civilly.
Take a breath; there's no need for that.
formal: That language is unacceptable; address me respectfully.
I will not be addressed in that manner.

swear: Still a cheeky bastard, aren't you?

default: Apology heard; give me a moment.
Fair enough; let's leave it there.
irritated: Words are easy; we'll see about the rest.

default: Not now; I've work to do.
Can't talk, I'm in the middle of something.
formal: I am occupied; please return later.
I regret I am engaged; come back later.
friend: Not now, friend; I've got work to finish.
Give me a bit, friend; I'm busy.

default: The service is closed for now.

formal: Good day; how may I assist?
friend: Good to see you; what do you need?
Ah, you're back; what can I do?
warm: Welcome in; what can I do for you?
Well met; how can I help?

formal: Farewell; may your road be safe.
warm: Take care of yourself; come back soon.
Safe journey, friend; come back soon.

default: Something I can do for you?
formal: Good day; may I be of assistance?
warm: Well, hello there; what brings you by?
Ah, a visitor; how can I help?
guarded: You there; what do you want?

default: That's not something I can tell you.
formal: I cannot speak to that matter.
admit_limit: That's all I know about it.
I've told you what I can.
I can't tell you more than that.
close_topic: I've nothing more to say on it.
challenge: You keep asking; why does it matter so much?
Why are you pressing me on this?
